app.name: Compendio
app.tagline: A Markdown folder that is the database of record

error.notFound: That page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

auth.failed: That user name and password do not match.

setup.title: Set up Compendio
setup.subtitle: Four short steps. Nothing here needs a database server or an internet connection.

language.heading: Which language should this instance use?
language.help: Everyone can choose their own afterwards. This is the default for people who have not.

account.heading: Create the administrator account
account.help: There is no email in Compendio, so keep these credentials somewhere safe. Recovery is a command on the server.
account.instanceName: What should this wiki be called?

content.heading: Where your pages live
content.help: Every page is a Markdown file in this folder. Open it in VS Code, back it up, sync it — it is yours.

access.heading: Who can read a new folder by default?
access.everyone: Everyone who signs in can read
access.everyoneHelp: The usual choice. You can restrict individual folders later.
access.nobodyHelp: For an instance where most content is sensitive.

https.heading: HTTPS (optional)
https.help: Compendio can issue its own certificate — no certificate authority, no internet, no purchase. Browsers will warn until you trust it, and the install guide shows how.

nav.deleteFolderCount_one: This removes {{count}} page that you can see.
nav.deleteFolderCount_other: This removes {{count}} pages that you can see.
nav.emptyTree: No pages yet. Create the first one.

page.noBacklinks: No other page links here yet.

page.notCanonical: This page was written outside Compendio. The first save here will tidy its formatting once.

editor.leaveConfirm: Leave without saving? Your changes will be lost.
editor.saveFailed: Could not save. Your text is still here — try again.
editor.saveForbidden: You do not have permission to save here. Your text is still here — ask an administrator for write access to this folder.

conflict.title: This page changed while you were editing
conflict.explain: Somebody else — or an edit made in the content folder — saved after you opened this page. Nothing is lost. Choose what to keep.
conflict.resolveOnDesktop: Merging needs a wider screen. Open this page on a computer to resolve it.

paste.converted: Pasted content was converted to formatted text.

search.noResultsHint: Try fewer words, or check the spelling.
search.filters: You can use tag:, in:, owner:, lang: and updated:> in the search box.
search.indexRebuilding: The search index is rebuilding. Results may be incomplete for a moment.

history.title: History of {{title}}
history.restoreConfirm: Restore the version from {{when}}? This adds a new version rather than removing anything, so it can be undone.
history.restored: Restored. A new version records the change.
history.noAuthor: No author — this change came from the content folder

user.roleHelp: A role is a ceiling, not a grant. A Reader can never write, whatever a folder's rules say.
user.saved: The person's details have been saved.
user.leaveBlankPassword: Leave blank to keep the current password.
user.lastAdmin: There must always be one active administrator.

group.name: Name
group.membersSaved: The group's members have been saved.

acl.title: Access to {{path}}
acl.restricted: Restricted — only the people and groups below
acl.previewFor: What can this person do here?

reason.secure.readOnly: because this folder is encrypted, and only administrators can change it

acl.noDeny: There are no deny rules. To take access away, cut inheritance and list who gets in.

secureScope.threatModel: This protects a stolen disk, a backup archive, a mis-synced folder and a future git mirror. It does not protect against an administrator of this server, and it does not hide folder or file names.
secureScope.filesFirstSuspended: Files-first is suspended inside an encrypted folder: runbook.md.enc does not open in VS Code. Use compendio secure export and import for a direct edit.
secureScope.indexContentWarning: Page contents will be stored unencrypted in the search index inside compendio.db. Anyone with the database file will be able to read them.
secureScope.allowAi: Allow AI features to read these pages
secureScope.allowAiConfirm: The contents of this encrypted folder will be sent to {{endpoint}} whenever somebody uses an AI action on a page inside it. Continue?
secureScope.allowAiOn: Pages here are sent to {{endpoint}} when an AI action is used on them.
secureScope.allowAiOff: The AI assistant cannot read these pages, and will not cite them.
secureScope.unavailable: Unavailable — run compendio doctor on the server

status.title: Status
status.backupHelp: Writes an archive of the content and database to the server's backups folder.
status.backupPassphraseHint: Required because this instance has encrypted folders. It protects the encryption key inside the archive — keep it somewhere other than this server, as you will need it to restore.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: Optional. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint covers Ollama, Groq, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LM Studio and vLLM. With nothing configured, no AI control appears anywhere in the product.
ai.baseUrlHint: The chat-completions base, without the trailing path. Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1
ai.modelHint: Use a standard instruct model, e.g. llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Reasoning models (gpt-oss, DeepSeek-R1, o-series) are slower, costlier and not recommended here.
ai.apiKeyStored: A key is stored. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
ai.apiKeyOptional: Optional. Ollama and LM Studio do not need one.
ai.privacyOn: Page content is sent to {{endpoint}} when somebody uses an AI action. A local model keeps it on this machine.
ai.privacyOff: No provider is configured, so nothing is sent anywhere and no AI control is shown.
ai.limitsIntro: A hosted endpoint charges per request. These caps bound what this wiki can spend in a day, counted over a rolling 24 hours. 0 means no limit. A request that fails at the provider still counts, because by then it has already cost money.
ai.dailyPerUserHint: Generous is right: an editor working through a dozen pages spends about forty.
ai.dailyPerInstanceHint: A second ceiling across the whole instance. Leave at 0 unless the endpoint is metered.
ai.allowedSpacesHint: Top-level folders the assistant may read. Leave empty for all of them.
ai.featuresHint: Unchecked features disappear from the product entirely, rather than failing when used.

git.title: Git mirror
git.disabled: Disabled. Enable it with GitMirror:Enabled and a remote URL.
git.noGit: Enabled, but git is not on PATH. Everything else is unaffected.

lifecycle.staleTitle: This page is due for review
lifecycle.staleBody: Owner: {{owner}}. Check it is still correct, then confirm.
lifecycle.ownerHint: Who is responsible for keeping this page correct. They get the reminders.
lifecycle.intervalHint: Leave empty for no review cycle. Setting this starts the clock from today.
lifecycle.requiresAcknowledgmentHint: Everyone who can read this page is asked to confirm they have.

acknowledgment.required: You must confirm you have read this page
acknowledgment.body: Read the page, then confirm. Your confirmation records this exact version.
acknowledgment.materialRevisionHint: Ask everyone to read it again

ai.proposalNote: From {{model}} at {{endpoint}}. Nothing is saved until you accept.
ai.proposalNoteReadOnly: From {{model}} at {{endpoint}}. Nothing has been changed — this is for you to read.
ai.unreviewedBody: This translation was produced by a model and nobody has checked it. Saving the page from the editor clears this notice.
ai.translateNote: A model produces the translation and nobody has checked it. The new page is badged unreviewed until a person saves it.
ai.askIntro: Answered only from pages you can read, using {{endpoint}}.
ai.askPlaceholder: What do you want to know?
ai.noAnswer: Nothing in the pages you can read answers that.
ai.unavailableTitle: Ask the wiki is not available
ai.unavailableBody: No AI provider is configured on this instance, or this feature has been switched off.
ai.working: Waiting for {{endpoint}}. A local model can take a minute or two.
ai.budgetRemaining: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} AI requests left for you today.
ai.draftTitle: Draft a page from your notes
ai.draftIntro: Type what you know in any shape — bullet points, half sentences, the order you happen to remember it. {{endpoint}} turns it into a structured page you can edit.
ai.draftNotesHint: Rough is fine. This is what most people find easier than a blank page.
ai.draftPlaceholder:
- restart the service from the console
- check the log at D:\logs
- if it fails twice, call Ana
ai.draftTemplateHint: Optional. Uses the same page templates as the rest of the wiki.
ai.draftUnsavedNote: The draft lands in the editor. Nothing is saved until you save it.
